description: Check web pages for changes on a schedule (daily digest, monitor): each URL is read with hidden text and prompt injections removed, compared with the last check under the same watch_id, and returned as new | changed | unchanged with only the added sections. Page text is never stored (only section hashes, kept 90 days). All-or-nothing; failures are not charged. Paid x402 $0.002 USDC per URL on Base (5 URLs = $0.010).

return.description: changes (default) returns only added sections; full returns the whole cleaned page

watch_id.description: Stable id for this watch list, e.g. 'my-daily-digest' (default: your paying wallet)

name: saferead_watch
